recognize_zh: 較高倍的 IgG4 染色可見許多細胞質強陽性的漿細胞，散在於淡染、陰性的大型組織球之間；IgG4+ 漿細胞增加可見於 Rosai-Dorfman 病，並非 IgG4 相關疾病的專屬證據。
features: Numerous plasma cells with strong cytoplasmic IgG4 staining
Positive plasma cells interspersed between larger pale, negative histiocytes
describe_en: At higher power, the IgG4 immunostain shows numerous plasma cells with strong cytoplasmic staining, interspersed among larger histiocytes with pale, unstained cytoplasm and occasional adipocytes. The density of IgG4-positive plasma cells is high in this field, but an IgG4/IgG ratio requires a paired IgG stain. In the context of S100-positive histiocytes with emperipolesis, these findings represent the IgG4-rich plasma cell component that may be seen in extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.vs: IgG4-RD shows storiform fibrosis, obliterative phlebitis, and elevated IgG4/IgG ratio (>40%) but lacks large S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis; increased IgG4+ plasma cells can occur in RDD and should not be used alone.
MZL may show IgG4+ plasma cells but has monotypic light-chain expression and a CD20+ B-cell infiltrate.
Plasmacytoma shows sheets of monotypic plasma cells and does not have admixed S100+ histiocytes.
